scope: Independent closed US unemployment rate (UNRATE), in percentage points; no tournament or inference calls
origins: Quarterly, March/June/September/December month-end, 1990-01 through 2024-12 inclusive; forecast at 00:00 UTC on the following day. Latest real-time date <= origin, ≤ origin observation dates only.
target: For horizons 1, 3, 6 months beyond the last available observation month, score the first recorded ALFRED release (after origin). Never use revised values as outcomes. Exclude nonconsecutive/missing latest 120 monthly inputs or missing target release. Use the fixed release calendar for purges.
splits: Train origins 1990-2006 with first publication before 2007-01-01; validation 2007-2015 with first publication before 2016-01-01; test 2016-2024 mature first publications. No test-driven choices; test outcomes never tune candidates.
arms: naive_rw: zero-drift Gaussian with horizon-scaled recent historical standard deviation, floor 0.05
empirical: center at last observation, historical h-month moves minus historical median, piecewise quantile interpolation with exponential tails
champion_rule: translate Market Pulse level rule (zero drift and sqrt(short/long vol) clipped 0.7..2.0, raw width 1); same monthly input, not a deployed per-question LLM decision
three_scales: equal mixture of empirical moves from 24, 60 and 120 months centered at latest level; common historical median shift
ridge_ar: ridge AR(1) centered on 120-month mean, slope shrunk towards one, Gaussian from historical h-step residuals
cqr_tails: five empirical champion quantiles adjusted by exact split-CQR normalized residual rank on train only, nonnegative expansion and 3% heavy-tail floor
support: Continuous approximation on [0,100] for all arms; renormalize CDF and density by truncation; enforce strictly increasing quantiles by minimum spacing 0.025 pp. Piecewise linear CDF with matched exponential tails, CQR adds 3% scaled Cauchy before truncation.
calibration: CQR-only: calibration per horizon from train origins, locked for validation/test; quantile rank ceil(0.8(n+1)). Other arms use fixed rules and no validation selection.
metrics: Mean discrete quantile CRPS approximation, 99 midpoint levels (2 x mean pinball); continuous negative log-density, Brier at origin rate plus 0.2pp, coverage and width 50/80, PIT histogram and max deviation from uniform; dates clustered moving-block bootstrap 4 quarters, 2000 replicates seed 20261124 for test paired CRPS gains. Positive gains improve. Report by horizon and COVID-19 era.
leakage_control: Diagnostic only: mirror champion_rule with the latest file vintage at the end of 2025 or earlier as available, use same set of observations and targets as honest arm; report signed delta real-time minus revised. Keep out of rankings. Record example revision and number affected.
thresholds: E2 measurable if >=150 total pairs. Statistical anchors require lower held-out CRPS and no worse Brier vs naive. Gemini full E2 additionally requires >=3% hybrid-vs-LLM gain without calibration decline; absent archived LLM pair = untested. E5 >=120 total, >=60 test; 80% coverage 74-86%; CRPS and continuous log both better than quantile and Gaussian baselines. Without archived LLM quantiles E5 is only a statistical proxy. No promotion with unresolved criteria or paired uncertainty including zero.
